## Darknet.scan() method

Get the list of darkweb servers connected to a server (or the current server if no hostname is provided). If `showAll` is true, instead returns ALL hostnames connected to the server, including non-darkweb servers.

**Signature:**

```typescript
scan(hostname?: string, showAll?: boolean): string[];
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  hostname | string | _(Optional)_ optional. Name of the server to get the list of servers connected to. Defaults to the current server if not provided. |
|  showAll | boolean | _(Optional)_ optional. If true, show all servers (not just darknet ones) connected to the specified server. Defaults to false. |

**Returns:**

string\[\]

an array of hostnames.

## Remarks

RAM cost: 0.2 GB
